svg.text: Three ways to weight the foot
All three drawn by FOLLOWING the width field up the stroke, not by sampling its two ends. The font’s own machinery samples the ends,
which is why what it built earlier was the second of these however the field was written.
what the earlier sheets actually showed
the swell eases back to R2’s line
y = 200, where the flare has faded out
stroke width up the left leg, in units
The flare is the only one of the three that leaves the letter’s middle and top exactly as they are: above y=200 it is R2’s own line.
